float32HighestRayAgreement.method: Every positive overlap pair, every polygon vertex, both affine height equations. Each per-face equation difference is affine; vertex extrema bound it over the polygon, and MAX difference cannot exceed the maximum per-face bound. This proves equations, not production sampler implementation or GPU raster equivalence.

policy: Retain original source surfaces plus explicitly recorded scripted transition and seam faces; select highest native surface. No model geometry edits or runtime/neighbour acceptance.

sourceAttribution.qualification: Exact numeric Float32 vertices, vertex order independent. No proximity tolerance. Other pairs may be clipped originals or transition/fill; no approval or geometry edit.
